ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The table has two columns, the left column is Time (s), and the right column is [N2O5] (M). The data in the table are: at 0 s, [N2O5]=0.250 M; at 500 s, [N2O5]=0.190 M; at 1000 s, [N2O5]=0.145 M; at 2000 s, [N2O5]=0.085 M. The problem asks for the concentration of N2O5 at t=1500 s. Reasoning: According to the specified method, treat the decomposition of N2O5 as a first-order reaction, and use the data at 1000 s and 2000 s to bracket 1500 s. k = ln(0.145/0.085)/(2000-1000) = 5.34×10^-4 s^-1. Extrapolate from 1000 s to 1500 s: [N2O5]1500 = 0.145 × exp[-k×(1500-1000)] = 0.145 × exp(-0.267) ≈ 0.111 M.
